name: 94115 · San Francisco, CA
findings: ZIP 94115 (San Francisco) has 269 nonprofit organizations. 111 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 81 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 94115 (San Francisco) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations stand out for public events
observations.text: 21 religious organizations here list public events, compared with about 9 in similar places of this size.
